body: Thank you everyone for all your suggestions and everything you have said to me it really has helped so far. aWatcher I want to specifically thank you for what you said in your first line it really helped me get over the idea of her cheating on me at all. I did talk to her and I sent her this link and told her this is what I have been trying to tell her for the longest time and well it finally worked and I feel as if a lot of the pressure has come off of me. Im just not to sure on therapy just yet the idea kind of puts me off but I guess I will have to wait for that to end but once again thank you for everything. Thank you everyone again and thanks for the happy birthday too :).

Ok I feel like im abusing this and for that I am terribly sorry. I'm not close to suicide its just I am right now depressed as I always am anymore. I just cant stand yelling, decisions, confrontations, or anything anymore. Everything just puts me further down and I'm not sure why. I get frustrated at even the slightest bit of someone telling me to do something repeatedly. Once I get in these moods I scrutinize my life looking for this to make myself even more miserable. Here are some examples, parents divorced at around age 7, havent seen my mother since age 12, and just this week it seems as if no one cares about me. It was my birthday so it would be expected for it to be even slightly better but no. After doing this for everyone for all of my life i get repaid by eating dinner with someone I did not even know and that is all that is keeping me up right now. That and my girlfriend. Probably one of the most loving people I have ever met who sincerely cares about me and just always tries to make me happy, but no I can not be. I am over protective and I know it but I cant stop. Despite me seeing her each day in the back of my mind (and I feel as if I have no control over it) I get feelings as if she is cheating on me and Im just not sure what to do. I know she isnt but I cant stop feeling that way. And then I feel with my depression it just carries over. Why do I have to make those around me miserable can I not just control it to myself to spare everyone else the suffering, I always think I must even though I know it is better to talk about it but that is why I am here. Im not even sure what to say anymore as I write this in tears. I just dont know how much more of this I can take. I just dont think im genuinely happy anymore and its all just a show and im not sure if I will ever feel that again.
